text_block_list.text:
One day, a TV special featuring past Muses was 
broadcast. A student I recognized appeared on screen—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I've won the title of Muse. 
I'm Gran Alegria. Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's ask our two guests about 
what it was like when they became Muses.
choice_data_list: （彼女、ミューズになれたんだ……！）

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing in particular to say. 
The crown has simply settled where it belongs.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I... finally became the Muse I dreamed of being. 
Yet, I'm still so frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Just what in the world happened at the Beauty Dream Cup...?! 
Let's check the footage for all the details!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This survival race is reaching its climax. 
What business might you have with me at such a time?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
5 miles left to the finish line. At this pace, 
we'll earn the right to propose.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I can't be satisfied with just that. 
Please face me in a match for the title of strongest Muse!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no need for that. 
Results naturally follow the truly strong... wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
!! Then I'll cross the finish line 
before Gentile-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
We've pulled a 0.2-mile lead...! 
At this pace, we can win!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu, how lovely.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The vines are tangling—whoa, it's so muddy?! 
This is a swamp...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, you certainly are taking your time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Good day.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
!! S-So incredible... 
It's like the vines and mud aren't even there—!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: So that's Gentil-senpai's power...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*... 
The more I struggle, the deeper I sink...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I can't... 
I can't push forward like Gentildonna-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Even so!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I am who I am! 
I'm going to become the greatest Muse my own way!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Everything above my legs is free. I can still totally fight...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I can reach that branch... All right! Relax my legs and—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, I got out of there~~~! 
I'd better make sure I don't fall into the swamp again!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Those vines look sturdy! 
Yeah, yeah... this might just work!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Jump from vine to vine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hraaah～～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: GOOOOOAL!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, good work. That was quicker than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-senpai...! 
...So I really did lose, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you still have the right to propose. 
Are you planning to forfeit?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...No, I won't give up on the proposal! 
I'll pour these feelings right into my Racewear!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I lost to Gentildonna-senpai. 
I don't think I'm the strongest right now...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still, the miles haven't ended. 
No matter what happens, I'm going to keep running!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And one day, without fail! I will prove 
that I am the strongest miler!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll let my racing silks witness that 
moment when I shine the brightest from the 
closest vantage point!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—So, I'm really frustrated. Because I 
couldn't become the ultimate muse!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet you haven't given up, have you? 
Knowing you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to challenge me as many times as 
you wish. I shall thoroughly turn the 
tables on you each time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's compete again, Gentil-senpai!
